_comment: The audience's conversation (V5.3, Gameplay's talk menu sections 1-4). One general rule reads this table (src/ui/talk_menu.gd): a line is offered only when its condition holds, tier by tier, at most `tier_limits[tier]` of a tier and `max_lines` in all; nothing fills the gap. `topic` is the EXISTING topic the line spends (Levers.talk); the words are the .dialogue titles talk_<id>, talk_<id>_yes, talk_<id>_no; `tag` names the glyph and words at the line's right end (talk_menu.gd's TAGS). A row 3 (their region) and a row for the unfilled tiers are absent on purpose: no person in the data carries a region, and a want only names a programme entry, an office or a meter.
